name: Collection First-Time Setup
description: Initial setup workflow when creating the web-ade-collections GitHub repository

scenarios.description: Creating first collection and initializing GitHub repository

template.introduction:
**First-Time Setup Complete**

Created your first collection **"{{collection.name}}"** and initialized GitHub sync.

A new public repository `web-ade-collections` was created at:
{{github.repo.url}}
template.summary:
**Setup Summary:**
- Repository created: {{github.repo.url}}
- Visibility: {{github.repo.visibility}}
- First collection: **{{collection.name}}** (`{{collection.id}}`)
- Storage type: {{storage.type}}

**What Happened:**
1. User created their first collection
2. System detected no existing `web-ade-collections` repository
3. Created new public GitHub repository
4. Initialized repository with auto_init
5. Waited 1 second for GitHub initialization
6. Synced collection data to new repository

**What's Next:**
- Your collections are now synced to GitHub
- Changes automatically sync across devices
- You can view the raw JSON at {{github.repo.url}}

**Files Created on GitHub:**
- `collections.json` - Collection metadata
- `collection-memberships.json` - Repository associations

**Architecture Flow:**
UI -> Context -> IPC -> Main Process -> GitHub Repo Check -> **Create Repository** -> Sync to GitHub -> Storage
